column1: Delphi Complete Works of William James|1890|0|10||6.5,5.5,6,5,5.5,8,4.5,9,6,7.5|William James|Collected psychological and philosophical works with letters and biography, not a single technical course or dictionary. The inclusion of psychology textbooks does not alone determine the purpose of this broad literary collection. Sivers read selected pragmatist material only; D=5.5 is low-confidence for the entire collection, whose length is not justified for this profile by selected strong passages. https://www.delphiclassics.com/shop/william-james/ and https://books.apple.com/us/book/delphi-complete-works-of-william-james-illustrated/id1443895560 document contents and 2018 digital compilation. P14 uses 1890, the first named volume's original year, so repackaging does not reset age; earlier essays also fall beyond the cap. No single historical period; T12 philosophy.

Reflections and Moral Maxims|1665|0|10||5.5,3,5,3,5.5,8.5,2,8,7,8|François de La Rochefoucauld|Nonfiction aphoristic moral psychology. Self-interest and self-deception offer transferable distinctions, but sweeping cynicism lacks systematic evidence. Source reader identifies formulaic reversals and a long translator preface; D=5.5 is edition-sensitive and low-confidence. https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/9105/pg9105-images.html supplies public-domain text and original 1665 date. Timeless maxims H13=0, not topic age inferred from publication. T12 philosophy; no no-payload veto merely for misanthropic tone.

Islam and the Future of Tolerance|2015|0|10||6.5,5.5,5.5,5,6.5,6.5,3.5,7,8,7|Sam Harris and Maajid Nawaz|Analytical dialogue about religious reform, extremism and political organization; neither scripture nor advocacy of violent extremism. Distinctions between religion and political movements supply some payload. Source finds discussion poorly matched to his interests, which does not establish V1/V2. D=6.5 remains a low-confidence estimate from report and contents, not a bonus for brevity. https://www.jstor.org/stable/j.ctvjf9xkq and https://www.samharris.org/books/islam-and-the-future-of-tolerance verify 2015. T12 political/philosophical content; cross-context argument has no period endpoint.

Palestine a Four Thousand Year History|2018|10|10||6.5,6,5,5,5.5,8,3.5,8,5.5,6|Nur Masalha|Historical identity and political geography across four millennia. Source reports fact accumulation with weak narrative; favorable trade review finds substantial historical detail. D=5.5 acknowledges learning while retaining low confidence about synthesis. Competing reviews are politically opposed; neither criticism of Zionism nor endorsement alone establishes V2. E remains cautious about continuity and selection claims. https://www.publishersweekly.com/9781786992727 verifies 2018 and historical scope. Both single-region national history and central politics apply; broad cross-period account H13=0.

Complete Idiot’s Guide to Hinduism|2002|0|10||5.5,4,4,3.5,5,7,1.5,7,6.5,6|Linda Johnsen|General exposition of Hindu traditions, not a ritual procedure course. Inspected notes largely report beliefs as beliefs; unlike explicit doctrinal advocacy, that does not establish V5. They also contain sweeping historical assertions and dated racial categories, lowering E. Source reader reports excessive named tales relative to conceptual learning; D=5 reflects that specific concern. https://books.google.com/books?id=8FDhwAEACAAJ confirms 2002. Philosophy/religious worldview T12 applies; no single historical period. Low confidence in veto assessment.

Hot Commodities|2004|0|10||6,7,6,6.5,6.5,5.5,6,8,7,6.5|Jim Rogers|Substantial sector explanations of supply, demand and production cycles, alongside entry-level investment guidance. The contents do not establish a primarily technical trading curriculum; retain with moderate eligibility confidence. Commodity forecasts and selected market examples limit durability and E. Sivers calls it specific market explanation, supporting provisional D=6.5. https://books.google.com/books/about/Hot_Commodities.html?id=JvmrAAAACAAJ verifies 2004 and contents. Central investing T12 applies; analysis across cycles has no single period endpoint. Old forecasts are not treated as current recommendations.

A Bull in China|2007|10|10||5.5,6,4.5,5,6,3.5,4.5,8,7,6|Jim Rogers|Sector-based investment argument about Chinese growth rather than a specialist trading curriculum. Transport, energy and agriculture provide explanatory context, but specific opportunity claims age quickly; low R and U retain that limitation. Sivers describes narrow market relevance; D=6 remains low-confidence from contents and reader report. https://catalogue.umu.ac.ug/bib/29486 and https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/156696/a-bull-in-china-by-jim-rogers/9781588365972/ verify 2007 and sector structure. Single-country and finance deductions both apply. Original forecasts are not presented here as current advice; no period endpoint for forward-looking thesis.

Cambodia’s Curse|2011|10|10|2009|3.5,5.5,5,3.5,6.5,6,3.5,6.5,7,5.5|Joel Brinkley|Counterfactual V1: specialist review identifies multiple concrete factual errors and a central unsupported explanation of persistent failure through allegedly fixed national character. Retain the review's acknowledgment of strong reporting on aid dependence and political events; D=6.5 is not reduced merely because E fails. https://bookshop.iseas.edu.sg/component/get/12809 documents both sides, including problems in introduction, chapter 17 and epilogue. https://www.publishersweekly.com/9781586487874 is a favorable counter-review. Original 2011; central period ends approximately 2009. Both national history and politics deductions apply. V1 moderate confidence.
